text:
Devon (Sales): Hey team -- passing Novus Health to CS. Signed SOW for Private (VPC) deployment, target go-live 2024-05-10. Primary contact is Raj Patel (raj@novushealth.com). Key requirements: Okta SSO, HIPAA data controls, burst capacity up to 500 concurrent requests for triage window. Renewal baseline 12mo; likely expand to Dedicated in Q3 if pilot metrics hit. Sales notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/NOTES-433

Anya (CSM): Thanks Devon — can you drop PO number and any legal/infra contacts? Also does the customer have a preferred support cadence during onboarding?

Devon (Sales): PO: PO-99321. Legal contact: emily+contracts@novushealth.com. Infra: Raj (same). They want weekly cadence for first 4 weeks, then biweekly. Also flagged: internal data team wants export logs and audit events forwarded to their Splunk instance.

Lydia (Solutions): Quick checklist from my side: model variant = small-med quantized for latency; we need list of data connectors (S3, internal API) and whether they plan store PII in Redwood or bring-through. Recommend 2-week enablement sprint: week1 infra/provisioning + SSO, week2 testing + runbook. I can own the runbook and initial eval prompts.

Sam (Support Eng): Noted. I'll open an ENG ticket for the SSO+network work: ENG-5421. Need SAML metadata + ACS URL from Raj, and their SP metadata for our IdP. Also confirm if they require cert pinning.

Devon (Sales): Raj confirmed they will provide SAML metadata and want cert rotation every 90 days. They also asked about maintaining audit logs for 7 years (compliance).

Sam (Support Eng): Perfect. Creating ticket now. ETA for initial SSO prototype env: 5 business days. For network/peering (VPC) I need the VPC CIDR ranges and contact for their cloud team.

Oncall Bot: Ticket ENG-5421 created by Sam — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-5421 :white_check_mark:

Anya (CSM): From a CS perspective — what are the renewal risks? Devon, any commercial pressure / discount clauses we should know about? Also want to capture training attendees and champion list during kickoff.

Devon (Sales): Renewal risk: medium. Exec sponsor is supportive (CFO), but technical champion unclear — Raj is infra lead but data team hasn't committed. They have a pilot budget; if adoption stalls we lose expansion. No special discounts beyond standard pilot pricing.

Lydia (Solutions): Success metrics to propose in kickoff: 1) pilot volume >= 20k tokens/day, 2) median latency < 200ms for 1k-token requests, 3) three internal playbooks validated (SSO, backup restore, incident runbook). If we hit those, recommend readiness for Dedicated proposal.

Anya (CSM): Action items then: 
- Anya: build 4-week onboarding plan + weekly agenda and share before 2024-04-26.
- Sam: ENG-5421 SSO ticket owner, gather SAML metadata + VPC CIDRs (ETA 5bd).
- Lydia: runbook + eval prompt set (share draft by 2024-04-24).
- Devon: intro email to Raj + legal contact to loop me in (ASAP).

Sam (Support Eng): Copy of SAML SP metadata we need (paste to them):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood-idp.example\">\n  <!-- sample metadata -->\n</EntityDescriptor>
```
Please send actual XML.

Devon (Sales): Will send intro now and include required contacts + timeline.

Anya (CSM): I'll schedule week1 kickoff for 2024-04-29. Also planning a short post-kickoff feedback survey to capture enablement gaps.

Lydia (Solutions): I'll add a short feedback rubric to the runbook (ease of provisioning, latency confidence, docs clarity).

Devon (Sales): FYI: CISO asked for a short security questionnaire — I'll upload to the shared drive and ping when ready.

Anya (CSM): Great. If anything blocked, tag me or escalate to #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
